rebuild-detailed.why: Rebuilt from scratch with other class names, a grid layout and css/main.css, but to the eye the same six pages with every link working and the same weight.

rebuild-vague.why: A docs site for Lumen with the six pages and working links, but its own green top-nav look, no sidebar, breadcrumbs or prev/next, thinner content and pages at the root instead of guide/.

near.why: The goal with a sidebar 12 px wider, headings 1 px bigger, a slightly different highlight and two changed words: you only notice by flipping.

one-page-wrong.why: Five pages perfect; the Configuration page has its sidebar dropped under the content, one obvious layout bug.

nav-incomplete.why: All six pages built, but nothing links to Deploy or Changelog, so a third of the docs cannot be reached.

links-rotten.why: Looks perfect, but about 28% of internal links (17 of 60) go to files that do not exist; every page is still reachable some way.

heavy.why: Looks and works perfectly, but every page inlines its own CSS plus an unused framework and a big bitmap: ten times the goal's size.

sloppy.why: Looks perfect and works, but no lang, no alt, unlabelled search box, h1 to h4 skips, center and font tags, duplicate ids, inline styles and unclosed tags.

half-built.why: Only the home and Install pages exist (right as far as they go); four of six pages missing and their nav links dead.

near.why: The goal with a slightly wider grid gap, a shorter hero, rounder buttons and two changed words.
